# DIRECTION — 02-atelier-printworks

## Design thesis
Atelier Møn Printworks is a night-watch instrument: first screen is the work journey (“enquire about a print edition.”), not marketing chrome; ban generic creative-agency blob gradients, stock loft photos. Composition: single object left, large type right.

## Subject grounding
Subject: Atelier Møn Printworks
Audience: curators and small brands commissioning limited runs.
Primary action: enquire about a print edition.
Products/work: letterpress posters, map editions, shop bags for island shops
Brand palette cues: chalk white, harbour ink, coral registration mark
Anti-references: generic creative-agency blob gradients, stock loft photos; generic creative-agency blob gradients, stock loft photos.

## Hierarchy
1) work object 2) required fields/states 3) enquire about a print edition. 4) validation/offline/success — no KPI theatre
